orbital_conventions.alignment: sector-wise maximum absolute cross-AO MO overlap assignment; lexicographic optimal ties; orthogonal Procrustes inside target energy-degenerate blocks; positive matched overlap for singletons
orbital_conventions.anchor_gauge: ordered AO projections into each energy-degenerate block, two-pass metric Gram-Schmidt; largest AO coefficient positive, lowest AO index on ties
orbital_conventions.ao_basis: STO-3G contracted real spherical Gaussian; PySCF cart=False
orbital_conventions.ao_order: provider atom/shell/component order; exact ao_labels serialized
orbital_conventions.degeneracy_grouping: ascending energy, each block total span <= tolerance; no transitive chaining
orbital_conventions.integral_convention: h[p,q]; eri[p,q,r,s]=(pq|rs) chemists ordering; real float64; all four AO indices transformed with final MO coefficients
orbital_conventions.jordan_wigner_bit_order: wire 0 is most significant displayed/basis-index bit
orbital_conventions.mo_order: occupied first (11), virtual after (4); anchor energy ascending within each sector
orbital_conventions.selection_information: coordinates, AO overlaps and SCF orbital degeneracies only; no correlated reference or candidate-circuit energies

scf_policy.failure_policy: stop and retain diagnostics; no automatic orbital restart, UHF replacement or geometry change
scf_policy.precision: float64 real AO/MO coefficients and integrals
scf_policy.solution_choice: single deterministic minao-initialized converged stable closed-shell RHF; no energy-based multi-start selection
scf_policy.stability_method: complete bounded orbital-response Hessians; symmetric eigensolver with residual checks
